description: This file defines the ResponseFactory class implementing PsrHttpResponseFactoryInterface to create HTTP response objects, specifically for the Slim framework. It includes a method to generate responses with optional status codes and reason phrases.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating PSR-7 Response objects, implementing ResponseFactoryInterface

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a new response object with an optional status code and reason phrase
